content.text: Updated: Mar. 26, 2026, 6:22 p.m.Published: Mar. 26, 2026, 6:21 p.m.Seattle Mariners' Josh Naylor celebrates after scoring during the fourth inning in Game 4 of baseball's American League Division Series against the Detroit Tigers Wednesday, Oct. 8, 2025, in Detroit. (AP Photo/Paul Sancya)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveWith ROOT Sports no longer operating, the Seattle Mariners new home is Mariners.TV, with the MLB taking over local broadcast responsibilities. Tonight, you can watch the Seattle Mariners Opening Day game against the Cleveland Guardians live at 7:10 p.m. PT for free with a free trial at either DIRECTV (channel 687 in most markets) or Fubo (look for the Mariners logo in the sidebar of the guide). You can try out these services for zero dollars today and decide which one fits your needs the best.All columns visible (no scrolling needed)What are the best ways to watch Seattle Mariners games in the 2026 MLB Season?Most local television providers will have access to Mariners games, and DIRECTV (free trial) and Fubo (free trial) are the best options to watch the games on a free basis tonight and decide if you’d like to subscribe to their respective services for the season haul.Either of the services listed above will get you all the games that are not nationally broadcast on services like AppleTV and Peacock, which will be this Friday (AppleTV Friday Night Baseball stream) and Sunday (streaming on Peacock).If you already have a cable provider, you’ll have to check your listings to see if Mariners.TV is available.Mariners.TV is also available as a standalone product, which costs $99.99 for the entire season, or $19.99 a month.
